newsitem.title: UK: BOE gilt dealing desk to be staffed overnight.
newsitem.headline: BOE gilt dealing desk to be staffed overnight.

text.p: The Bank of England said its gilt dealing desk would be staffed overnight tonight to monitor market developments as results of the election become known.
"The Bank odes not expect to deal in gilts during the night," it said in a statement.

"If there were a substantial upwards adjustment in the market giving rise to strong demand during the night, the Bank may be prepared to supply conventional stock, but only for normal market management purposes, to enable GEMMs to continue to provide a service to investors overnight."
Any stock made available would be in the form of taps and would be announced on the Bank's screen pages.

"The shop window will not be open overnight and the Bank will not consider offers of switches during the night. Nor does the Bank expect to conduct transactions in index-linked gilts," the statement added.
During the last election in 1992, the Bank sold 1.6 billion stg of gilts in an unprecedented middle-of-the-night operation as gilts rose around three points on a surprise Conservative victory.
This time, with markets expecting a comfortable Labour victory, most financial houses plan only skeleton cover in the early hours of Friday.
Polls close at 2100 GMT and the first results should start coming in around an hour later.
